title: Roasted Red Pepper and Walnut Dip
summary: A smoky, slightly sweet Middle Eastern-style dip with roasted peppers, toasted walnuts, and garlic. It’s great with flatbread, crackers, or fresh vegetables as a snack or mezze starter.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Put the red bell peppers on a baking tray and roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until blistered and softened.
Tip the hot peppers into a bowl, cover with a plate, and leave for 5 minutes. Peel off the skins, remove the seeds, and roughly chop the flesh.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant, then let them cool slightly.
Add the roasted peppers, walnuts, breadcrumbs, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, cayenne, salt, and black pepper to a food processor.
Blend until mostly smooth but still slightly textured. Taste and adjust the seasoning or lemon juice if needed.
Transfer to a bowl and serve at room temperature with pita, flatbread, or vegetable sticks.
